scope: Twelve original Countercurrent reward still candidates, three maps across four themes. No runtime, catalog, saved/earned binding, production count or release adoption.
generation: Twelve independent text-only generation calls, in four groups of three. No generation retries, image edits, original crop/stretch/resampling/re-encoding. Separate review thumbnails are declared in derivatives.json.
rightsScope: Original fictional AI-generated project illustrations. No input reference images, copied game art, named artist imitation or authentic historical/product representation. Ukraine uses broad material/craft cues; Retro equipment is invented. No exclusive-rights or human-quality certification.

layoutAuthority.source: Separately owned Countercurrent worktree; layout cues provided by its author. Not a runtime dependency of this art batch.
layoutAuthority.limits: Geometry cue only; no copied gameplay implementation or gameplay/native proof.

review.agent: All twelve actual generated images inspected visually; per-image deviations retained. Small derivative readability is recorded separately.
review.root: Independent root visual review remains separate; no approval is inferred from verification.
review.limits: Source-art production only, no browser/partial-reveal/device/gameplay/animation or full-quality certification.
